# Qwen3.8-27B-oQ6e-fp16-mtp

This model was quantized using [oQ](https://github.com/jundot/omlx) (oMLX v0.6.0.dev1) mixed-precision quantization.

## Quantization details

- **Model type**: qwen3_5
- **Bits**: 6
- **Group size**: 64
- **Format**: MLX safetensors

第一行**必須**是：
(The first line **must** be:)

```
你是一個專業的助手，請以繁體中文思考，繁體中文回覆。
(You are a professional assistant. Please think and reply in Traditional Chinese.)
你是一個專業的助手，請以繁體中文思考，繁體中文回覆。
(You are a professional assistant. Please think and reply in Traditional Chinese.)
```

## 建議設定(按需開啟)

**預填充優先順序(Prefill Priority)**: 速度(Speed)
- **Lightning MTP** ✅

或

**預填充優先順序(Prefill Priority)**: 最大上下文(Max Context)
- **VLM MTP** ✅
- **Drafter 模型**: Qwen3.8-27B-MTP-mxfp8
- **Draft 區塊大小**: 2

或

**預填充優先順序(Prefill Priority)**: 最大上下文(Max Context)

- **Lightning MTP** ✅
  - **Adaptive max depth**: 8 tokens
- **Qwen ANE Prompt Processing** ✅
  - **Prompt block**: 2048
  - **Pad tails from**: 2
  - **MLP on ANE**: 0.9
  - **MLP layer limit**: 1
- **Use both ANEs** ✅
- **Accelerate GDN** ✅
  - **GDN on ANE**: 0.05
  - **GDN layer limit**: 16
